item.title: StupidMirror 0.7.0
item.description:
• Watch and operate the phone from Claude Code. The new open_viewer tool starts capture and returns a link to a live viewer page on this Mac. In the Claude desktop app's Code tab, Claude opens it in the Browser pane itself, adding a stupidmirror-viewer entry (origin only) to the project's .claude/launch.json; elsewhere it shows the link. The page reuses the Codex panel: live local WebRTC video with a PNG fallback, device picker, refresh and manual control. Annotation is hidden there because no chat receives it.
  • The viewer link carries a single-use ticket that expires after 10 minutes, in the URL fragment so it is never sent in a request or Referer. The page trades it for a tab session that can call only the four panel tools; the MCP bearer token never reaches the page. Host and Origin are checked, and rotating the token or stopping the server ends every open viewer.
  • Fix list_devices, refresh_devices and list_apps in Claude Code, which rejected their results because the device or app list was returned as a bare array. Structured results now wrap the list as devices or apps; the text result is unchanged.
  • Tell Claude Code to call show_screen before reading the screen. It starts background capture without opening a Mac window, so observe_screen has a frame. Screen errors now name show_screen alongside start_mirror, and the tool's description no longer reads as Codex-only.
  • observe_screen right after show_screen waits up to a few seconds for the first frame instead of failing while capture starts.
  • Fast OCR no longer garbles Chinese. Apple Vision's fast mode reads Latin scripts only, so a request that includes Chinese or another script is read in accurate mode.
  • Keep the installed Claude Code plugin current: connecting again updates Claude Code's cached copy, and after an app update StupidMirror refreshes the plugin by itself when it was already installed.
